_comment: The scenario taxonomy every generated case must be tagged against. Source: the user's Availability-policy coverage model (2026-08-12). scripts/cases.mjs validates every tag against this file and refuses unknown tags.

core.Functional: Happy-path / positive scenarios — feature works as designed (form fields, operators, macros resolving, save+trigger flow)
core.Impacted: Cross-feature impact verification — what happens downstream when this thing happens (active alerts, license counts, tile updates, related entities)
core.Edge: Boundary cases, race conditions, unusual values, empty/null, max-length, zero-match, unicode, decimal precision, locale separators
core.Regression: Watch-list against past bugs + spec invariants (e.g. flap() prevents duplicates, ABOVE_OR_BELOW splits correctly, soft-delete name-reuse, monitor-name in export populated)

negative_security.Negative: Explicit failure paths — invalid inputs (blank required, malformed JSON, invalid regex, expired tokens, missing creds, 401/403 responses, validation rejections)
negative_security.Security: XSS payloads in name/macro values, SQL-injection literals, CSRF protection, RBAC (Viewer/Operator scope), CSV-injection sanitization (= + - @ prefix), secret masking in audit, system-policy delete blocked

surface.Alert Screen: Active Alerts page UI (columns, sort, filter, search, pagination, bulk ack/clear, detail page with Notification/Runbook/Incident logs, History tab)
surface.UI: Form UI elements (placeholders, collapsible sections, info-icons, tile selection, dropdown behavior, sticky bars, mobile breakpoint)
surface.Reports: Predefined + scheduled + custom report builder, export formats (PDF/HTML/CSV/XLSX/JSON), data correctness vs Active Alerts
surface.Audit: EVENT_AUDIT verification for every CRUD/lifecycle action, retention, immutability, SIEM forwarding, correlation IDs
surface.Suppression: Manual suppress, Maintenance Windows, per-stage selective (notify-only/action-only/incident-only), policy-level POLICY_SUPPRESS_WINDOW
surface.Dashboard: Tiles (per severity), Recent Alerts widget, NOC View, Top-N widgets, websocket real-time updates, custom dashboards
surface.Workflow: Cross-stage resilience: notify-fails-TA-still-runs, runbook-fails-incident-still-created, stage order, RPE restart mid-action, MD031 worker timeout
surface.Mid-life: Policy composition while alerts are open: P1 active -> create P2 same counter, edit P1 mid-alert, delete P1 with P2 existing, race conditions
surface.Lifecycle: Export/Import JSON, version history, diff, rollback (non-destructive), simulation/dry-run, dependency map

quality.Non-Functional: Performance budgets, responsive breakpoints and zoom, accessibility (keyboard, labels, focus order), cross-browser consistency. Counts as a primary tag — a non-functional case does not also need a Functional/Negative tag.

grounding_sources.kg: read out of shipped source via the motadata-kg / ui-kg MCP servers
grounding_sources.figma: MUST be confirmed against the ticket's Figma node before this case can pass
grounding_sources.inferred: not verified anywhere — goes to the human gate as a review item
